verdict.score_rationale: The board lands at the 6–6.5 anchor because its spacious, clearly tinted sections remain readable with effort, but very small text and several long feedback/rebuild routes prevent fluent arm’s-length reading.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Stages and most label chips have generous surrounding space, though the tiny labels and tighter routing around sections 5, 7, and 8 slow arm’s-length reading.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Ten pastel-tinted, numbered section boxes make node membership immediately apparent without requiring edge tracing.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Most local arrows are clean, but the dashed “prioritize gaps” route and the long current-generation/rebuild paths span large portions of the board and force substantial visual backtracking.

sub_checks.name: density_and_decomposition
sub_checks.note: Air clearly dominates and sections generally contain only two to four nodes, but the oversized board spreads the workflow so widely that text and symbols become unusually small in the final view.
